rationale.quality-debt: Copilot adoption increased rework, indicating technical debt and reduced maintainability.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Core developers reviewed more while their original-code productivity fell sharply.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: The 6.5% review increase and 19% productivity drop anchor the problem.
rationale.assistive: GitHub Copilot supplies suggestion-granularity code within human-led development.
rationale.metrics: Defines PR rework as a quality technical-debt metric.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports empirical quality and maintainability degradation after Copilot introduction.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes shallow reliance by less-experienced contributors and learning consequences.
rationale.method-mining: Uses mined GitHub repository, pull-request, commit, and review activity.
